note: scanners/inputs.jsonl.gz holds the inputs; each scanner file holds one result per input, in order

scanners.units_target: units.py:117 _TARGET as _IS_TARGET.match(text): the end of the match, or null
scanners.units_sentence_end: units.py:284 _SENTENCE_END.finditer(line): [start, end of group 1, end of group 2]
scanners.units_opener: units.py:314 _OPENER.match(line, pos) at every pos: [pos, end] where it matches
scanners.units_named: units.py:404 _NAMED.match(line): [start, end] of group 1 and the match end, or null
scanners.slack_mapping_percent: slack_mapping.py:108 the pattern parse_thread_selection searches a thread link's query with, %(?![0-9a-fA-F]{2}): [start, end] of each match
scanners.slack_callback_percent: slack_callback.py:163 the pattern _callback_fields searches the sign-in callback's query with, %(?![0-9A-Fa-f]{2}): [start, end] of each match
